source_title: A General Dixmier Trace Formula for the Density of States on Open Manifolds (SIGMA 20 (2024), article 007)
title: Dixmier trace formula for density of states on bounded-geometry manifolds with Property (D)
core_obligations: The author establishes the weight and heat-commutator hypotheses rather than assuming them: uniform local Dirichlet resolvent estimates are glued using left-disjoint partition families, the reciprocal ball-volume weight is shown weak-L1, and Property(D) gives annular derivative summability making the heat commutator trace-class. These constructions are the residual work beyond standard Lorentz ideal inequalities, Weyl asymptotics and the cited zeta/Dixmier theorem. The concluding density argument is routine and is not itself the difficulty basis.
proof_roadmap: One main manifold theorem; abstract operator trace bridge, local estimates, Roe-index application and random-operator example retained as full context, not separate counts. Complete author source and inline bibliography retained.
